regions.today: Patchy light rain pushing in from the west later this evening, with a moderate to fresh southerly breeze.
regions.tonight: Tonight will be cloudy with outbreaks of rain or drizzle. Lowest temperatures of 6 to 9 degrees with a moderate to fresh southerly breeze becoming light overnight.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow morning will start cloudy with outbreaks of rain or drizzle, and also some heavy showers in the south. This will all clear later in the morning and it will become dry and breezy with clear spells for the afternoon and evening. Highest temperatures of 8 to 11 degrees with blustery northwesterly winds, decreasing moderate later. Temperatures will fall quickly after dark tomorrow evening with frost developing.
